product.name: Comprehensive AI Development
product.description: Provides end-to-end AI solution development including planning, implementation, evaluation, and validation tailored to business needs.

product.name: Real-Time Optimization
product.description: Automates continuous fine-tuning and optimization of AI models using company-specific data to maintain performance.

product.name: Secure Deployment Options
product.description: Offers AI deployment either in managed cloud environments or on-premise to meet security and compliance needs.

product.name: Full-Stack AI Support
product.description: Delivers support for a range of AI applications including retrieval-augmented generation conversational bots and autonomous agents.

product.name: Developer SDKs
product.description: Provides software development kits in Python, JavaScript, Java, and other languages for integrating AI into existing technology stacks.

product.name: Customizable Admin Dashboard
product.description: Allows management and control of AI system access and permissions through an adjustable administrative interface.
